title: 第19章 破局
novel_title: 长生：我体内有一片坟陵
content_zh:
“没冤枉我，我认罪，李构是我杀的。”

    苏牧坦然对视看向聂无极，稍稍提高了些音量，让场内之人听清自己的话语。

    他本寄希望于冯远清，可苦苦熬了七个多时辰的酷刑，对方都没有露面，只怕是不会出现了。

    眼下的局势，除了认罪这一条路，他别无选择。

    如白从义内心推测，他只能以‘受害者被迫反杀’为自己辩驳，希望聂无极会顾虑强者的身份和脸面，再辅以‘血魂丹’的重要情报，或可谋求到一线生机。

    否则，即便聂无极不认可他是凶手的论断，执法殿为了继续查找真凶，也难保不会继续在他身上下功夫，发掘新的有力证据，比如查看识海，甚至私下使用搜魂禁术。

    毕竟，他确实就是真凶，又有诸多疑点在身。

    苏牧不敢赌，相比杀死李构，识海藏坟陵这件事更为致命。

    此刻，聂无极听得确切的回答，皱眉盯着问：“怎么杀的？用毒？”

    苏牧简单答道：“搏杀。”

    聂无极仿佛听到了天大的笑话，再次气笑出声，笑声中带着几分怒气。

    “好好好，来，告诉我，你是怎么杀的李构？！”

    外人不了解李构，但身为师尊的聂无极自是清楚得很，李构天生神魂强大，法体同修，在炼气修士中具有相当的战斗力。

    在他眼里，除了用毒，一个才刚突破至炼气六层的普通外门弟子，是绝无可能以搏杀的方式杀掉李构的。

    而且在来执法殿的路上，他听林语山说了些大致的审讯情况，知道苏牧不具备作案时间，那就得先擒住李构，这比直接击杀更难数倍。

    此外，哪怕是深夜在偏僻位置，激斗一起，元气波动也会引来注意，这说明苏牧必须在极短的时间内完成从搏杀重伤对手，到生擒这一系列动作，几乎等同于无声无息。

    苏牧斟酌着措辞，正要答话，眼角余光却瞥见走廊上又出现两道身影，定睛一瞧，正是齐子濯和冯远清。

    聂无极跟着扭头朝门口扫去，眼中闪过一丝狐疑。

    冯远清脸上露出笑容，迈步进入审讯室，拱手行礼：“见过聂师叔。”

    齐子濯迟疑一瞬，也跟着进了屋，瞧见惨不忍睹的苏牧，面皮狠狠地抽搐了一下。

    聂无极微微颔首，说了句‘远清啊’，然后没再理会，重新看向苏牧。

    心思电转间，苏牧当场翻供，声音沙哑生涩，语气透着一丝无奈道：“好吧，弟子是被屈打成招的。”

    闻言，白从义眉毛一挑，瞥了冯远清一眼，朝苏牧冷哼道：“见到靠山来了想翻供？你以为冯长老会罔顾宗门法度为你开脱罪行？可笑至极！”

    冯远清笑呵呵道：“我只是路过，见聂师叔在，好奇进来瞧瞧。”

    白从义暗自腹谤，朝聂无极用力抱拳道：“聂峰主，人证物证俱在，此子确为真凶，您来之前，他已有认罪意图，您到之后，他更是供认不讳，此刻前后反复，其心可诛！”

    “听他说。”聂无极淡漠回了句，与苏牧道：“本座要听实话。”

    苏牧喉咙滚了滚，缓缓道来：“所谓物证，不过是巡夜弟子手提的一盏油灯，那巡夜弟子住我隔壁，共用轮值室，我拿过油灯残留下指纹属于正常现象，算不得证据，何况，巡夜弟子消失于李师兄死亡的前一夜，两件事是否有关联，犹未可知。”

    “至于人证……”

    苏牧嘴角扯出一丝笑意看向白从义道：“白长老所说的证人，应该是陈旭飞吧？这名字我是从长老口中第一次听说，我不知他为何污蔑于我，但我肯定，他在说谎，白长老可以将人叫来，当面对质！”

    说着，他又转头看向聂无极：“您来之前，弟子经历酷刑七个时辰之久，已无意志支撑，与其被折磨痛苦死去，倒不如认罪来得痛快些。”
content_en:
"I was not wronged. I plead guilty. I was the one who killed Li Gou."

    Su Mu looked at Nie Wuji calmly and raised his voice slightly so that the people in the room could hear his words clearly.

    He originally placed his hope in Feng Yuanqing, but after enduring more than seven hours of torture, the other party did not show up, and he was afraid that he would never show up.

    In the current situation, he had no choice but to plead guilty.

    As Bai Congyi speculated in his heart, he could only defend himself by saying that "the victim was forced to fight back." He hoped that Nie Wuji would care about the identity and face of the strong man, and supplemented by the important information of the "Blood Soul Pill", he might be able to find a chance of survival.

    Otherwise, even if Nie Wuji does not agree with the conclusion that he is the murderer, in order to continue to find the real murderer, there is no guarantee that the Law Enforcement Palace will not continue to work on him and discover new strong evidence, such as examining the sea of ​​​​consciousness, and even privately using soul-searching forbidden techniques.

    After all, he is indeed the real murderer, and there are many doubts about him.

    Su Mu didn't dare to bet. Compared with killing Li Gou, hiding the tomb in the sea was more deadly.

    At this moment, Nie Wuji heard the exact answer, frowned and stared and asked: "How to kill? With poison?"

    Su Mu simply replied: "Fight."

    Nie Wuji seemed to have heard a big joke and laughed angrily again, with a bit of anger in his laughter.

    "Okay, okay, come on, tell me, how did you kill Li Gou?!"

    Outsiders don't know Li Gou, but as a master, Nie Wuji knows very well that Li Gou is born with a powerful soul, a fellow practitioner of the law body, and has considerable combat effectiveness among Qi refining monks.

    In his eyes, apart from using poison, it was absolutely impossible for an ordinary outer disciple who had just broken through to the sixth level of Qi Refining to kill Li Gou by fighting.

    Moreover, on the way to the Law Enforcement Hall, he heard Lin Yushan talk about the general situation of the interrogation. He knew that Su Mu did not have the time to commit the crime, so he had to capture Li Gou first, which was several times more difficult than killing him directly.

    In addition, even if there is a fierce fight in a remote location late at night, the vitality fluctuations will attract attention. This shows that Su Mu must complete the series of actions from fighting and seriously wounding the opponent to capturing alive in a very short period of time, which is almost the same as silently.

    Su Mu considered his words and was about to reply when he caught sight of two more figures appearing in the corridor from the corner of his eye. When he looked closely, it was Qi Zizuo and Feng Yuanqing.

    Nie Wuji then turned and glanced towards the door, a trace of suspicion flashing in his eyes.

    Feng Yuanqing showed a smile on his face, stepped into the interrogation room, raised his hands and saluted: "I have met Master Nie."

    Qi Zizuo hesitated for a moment, then followed him into the house. When he saw the miserable Su Mu, his face twitched violently.

    Nie Wuji nodded slightly and said, "Yuan Qing", then ignored it and looked at Su Mu again.

    Suddenly, Su Mu retracted his confession on the spot, his voice was hoarse and jerky, and he said with a hint of helplessness: "Okay, the disciple was beaten into submission."

    Hearing this, Bai Congyi raised his eyebrows, glanced at Feng Yuanqing, and snorted at Su Mu: "You want to retract your confession when you see your backer? Do you think Elder Feng will ignore the sect's laws and excuse your crimes? How ridiculous!"

    Feng Yuanqing laughed and said, "I was just passing by and saw Uncle Nie here, so I came in out of curiosity to have a look."

    Bai Congyi secretly slandered him, and clasped his fist hard towards Nie Wuji and said: "Master Nie, there are all the witnesses and material evidence. This boy is indeed the real murderer. Before you came, he had the intention to plead guilty. After you arrived, he confessed even more. He has been repeating it again and again at this moment. His heart is to be punished!"

    "Listen to him." Nie Wuji replied indifferently, and said to Su Mu: "I want to listen to the truth."

    Su Mu's throat rolled, and he slowly said: "The so-called physical evidence is just an oil lamp carried by the night watch disciple. The night watch disciple lives next door to me and shares the same duty room. The fingerprints left behind after I took the oil lamp are normal and cannot be considered evidence. Besides, the night watch disciple disappeared the night before Senior Brother Li's death. It is still unclear whether the two events are related."

    "As for witnesses..."

    Su Mu looked at Bai Congyi with a smile on his lips and said, "The witness mentioned by Elder Bai should be Chen Xufei, right? This is the first time I heard this name from the elder. I don't know why he slandered me, but I am sure that he is lying. Elder Bai can call the person and confront him!"

    As he said that, he turned to look at Nie Wuji: "Before you came, this disciple had been tortured for seven hours and had no willpower to support him. Rather than being tortured and dying in pain, it would be more pleasant to confess his sins."
